explanation: Merge of main into the staleness pass. From main: From main (PR #84): Survey view tests run single-gene flows through GenePageSurvey and the survey page through its handoff. Card tests cover the tile rows, each tile opening its own source under its row, releasing the focus, the handed-over scope and the HypoMap tile; familyTeaser.test.ts covers the study-library and tissue summaries, and the NeuroSeq teaser tests now match the survey's default without SFO records. The GSE162563 catalog test merged from main now selects by mode instead of section. symbolRenames.test.ts covers decoding, authority scoping, pickStoredMember, compareCell and the compare-set summary under a renamed symbol, and renamedStudies; queryIndex.test.ts covers both query paths reading a retired member, own-row precedence, several partners, authority scoping and an absent table, and counts the rename table beside the two index requests. symbolRenames.test.ts also checks that the Compare tab's workbook, CSVs and long rows read a renamed column as the tiles do, and stay 'not detected' without the table. From this branch: From main (PR #85): symbolRenames.test.ts covers decoding, authority scoping, pickStoredMember, compareCell and the compare-set summary under a renamed symbol, and renamedStudies; queryIndex.test.ts covers both query paths reading a retired member, own-row precedence, several partners, authority scoping and an absent table, and counts the rename table beside the two index requests. symbolRenames.test.ts also checks that the Compare tab's workbook, CSVs and long rows read a renamed column as the tiles do, and stay 'not detected' without the table. From this branch: From main: setup.ts unmounts the page before it resets the URL after each test, because unmounting runs the router's pending URL write and Testing Library's own cleanup runs after this hook; testIsolation.test.tsx pins that order. app.dataset.test.tsx unmounts before it removes the mouse study's seeds, so a mounted page cannot start a load that stays cached for the next test. nomenclature.test.tsx checks that Enter selects the gene typed before the list catches up. From this branch: Survey view tests run single-gene flows through GenePageSurvey and the survey page through its handoff. Card tests cover the tile rows, each tile opening its own source under its row, releasing the focus, the handed-over scope and the HypoMap tile; familyTeaser.test.ts covers the study-library and tissue summaries, and the NeuroSeq teaser tests now match the survey's default without SFO records. Rename coverage: symbolRenames.test.ts covers decoding, authority scoping, pickStoredMember, compareCell and the compare-set summary under a renamed symbol, and renamedStudies; queryIndex.test.ts covers both query paths reading a retired member, own-row precedence, several partners, authority scoping and an absent table, and counts the rename table beside the two index requests. In the merge, main's GSE162563 catalog test selects sources by the gene survey's mode ('populations' or 'tissue'), the field that replaced section on this branch. Review fixes: surveyHandoff.test.ts covers the one-visit handover; familyTeaser, portalCards and expressionSurveyView tests cover unread sources, species naming, signed bars, the library fallback releasing a tile and catalog details showing loaded values; symbolRenames and queryIndex tests cover malformed rows, Compare tab downloads and the partner-shard fallback. From this branch: explorerStore.test.tsx and setup.ts comments say index.html eager-loads nothing; studyFactTable.test.tsx follows the study record's pathway-row wording; summaryTableFormat.test.tsx pins the gene summary FDR column to the shared p/q rule.
